newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: UN ship arrives to take staff from Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: UN ship arrives to take staff from Sierra Leone.

text.p: A United Nations-chartered ship has arrived in Sierra Leone to evacuate U.N. staff and their dependents, diplomats said on Tuesday.
Diplomats said the El Salvatore had arrived on charter from Liberia and the evacuation of non-essential U.N. staff and their dependents was expected to start on Wednesday.
"It is not clear how they will get people to the ship," one diplomatic source said.
Foreign pressure mounted against soldiers who seized power in the West African state, where hospital sources said at least 40 people were killed in fighting on Sunday.

Three Nigerian frigates with troops docked in Freetown on Tuesday after intense speculation that the regional super-power would intervene in the coup in which a battalion of its peacekeeping troops was drawn into fighting.
A U.S. navy helicopter ship with 1,200 Marines headed for Sierra Leone.
